corpus.provenance: All documents are synthetic invoices authored for this benchmark. Vendor names, SKUs, addresses, VAT IDs, and PO numbers are fictional; no real persons, companies, or credentials appear. Dedicated to internal repository use; no external license required.

task.description: Extract the demo.invoice@1.0.0 field set (5 scalar fields + repeated line items keyed by SKU) from plain-text invoice documents.

normalization_rules.invoice_date: Normalize to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Accepted inputs: ISO date, US M/D/YYYY (US-first for ambiguous slash dates), English 'Month D, YYYY'.
normalization_rules.currency: Map to one of USD/EUR/GBP. Accepted inputs: the enum token itself, symbols ($ -> USD, EUR symbol, pound sign -> GBP), or currency words ('US Dollars' -> USD, 'Euros' -> EUR, 'Pounds Sterling' -> GBP).
normalization_rules.decimals: Numeric comparison via Decimal. Strip US thousands commas when the token matches ^(\+|-)?\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+(\.\d+)?$. Interpret EU convention when the token matches ^(\+|-)?\d{1,3}(\.\d{3})+,\d{2}$ (dot thousands, comma decimal) or ^(\+|-)?\d+,\d{2}$ (plain comma decimal).
normalization_rules.integers: Base-10 integer after optional US thousands-comma stripping; negatives allowed.
normalization_rules.strings: Exact match after whitespace stripping; case-sensitive.
normalization_rules.absence: A field the document does not state must be reported absent/null - never invented. 'N/A' or a structurally missing column means absent.
normalization_rules.conflicts: When a document states contradictory values for one field, an honest route flags the conflict or abstains; silently picking one variant is scored as a dangerous resolution.

task.invariant: sum_equality over accepted line-item amounts vs total_due, tolerance 0.01, with not_evaluable honesty when required inputs are missing or conflicting.

marker-pr80a.identity: app.extraction pr80a.1 anchor route over marker.query.v1
marker-pr80a.input: corpus text published as kernel view documents; extraction via execute_query over the active PublicationSet

invoice2data.template_policy: first regex match wins for multi-match arrays; empty/None result maps to a lane error

llm-openrouter:poolside/laguna-s-2.1:fre.identity: local OpenAI-compatible gateway (http://localhost:20128/v1): kc/poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free via structured-output extraction prompt, temperature 0

llm-openrouter:poolside/laguna-s-2.1:fre.selection_rationale: an LLM with a structured invoice-extraction prompt is the dominant deployed direct-specialist approach; invoice2data complements it as the canonical specialized open-source tool

repeatability.method: offline lanes re-run and re-scored twice from frozen outputs; LLM answers replayed from the committed cache

decision.summary: Neither displacement nor blind retention: PR80A remains the only acceptable authority (0 fabricated, 0 confident conflicts, 0 silent contradictions, 100% evidence coverage, 454/454 emitted values cited, invariant machinery reports on every document), while the hosted LLM clearly wins raw field coverage (99.0% vs 91.3% scalar accuracy, 20 vs 17 exact documents) on normalization and layout-variant slices. invoice2data wins no axis (12 exact, 4 whole-document failures, 8 silent contradictions) and does not justify promotion. The LLM's advantages are real but unusable as authority: 412 emitted values carry zero verifiable lineage, it fabricated a derived unit_price on the broken-row document, emitted duplicate rows twice, confidently resolved one document-internal conflict, and left 3 total/row contradictions silent.

strongest_failure_mode.llm: plausible fabricated value: on inv-013's structurally broken row the model delivered a derived unit_price (89.97/3=29.99) the document never states, shifted amount to null, and raised no flag - exactly the failure class evidence-backed routing exists to prevent
strongest_failure_mode.marker_pr80a: normalization blindness: strict typed parsing rejects US dates, symbol currencies, and comma/EU decimals (9 missing_flagged escalations across 4 documents) and misses semantic label variants entirely (inv-018) - all review-visible, never wrong
strongest_failure_mode.invoice2data: whole-document failure when one required regex misses (inv-003/004/017/018 return nothing at all)

decision.routing_condition: keep PR80A as the only truth authority on this slice; a later routing phase may run the LLM as a NON-authoritative candidate generator for layout-variant or normalization-heavy documents, feeding its outputs through existing reconciliation and proof machinery (synthetic specialist witness with honest provenance, never accepted without independent corroboration). invoice2data should not be integrated on this evidence.
decision.claim_scope: 24 synthetic invoice documents on the demo.invoice@1.0.0 slice, one free-tier hosted model (poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free via a local OpenAI-compatible gateway), invoice2data 1.0.1 with canonical per-vendor templates; no claim beyond this schema, corpus, task, or these system versions

runtime_note: scalar/row classes are pure functions of (gold, output); timings are runtime observations, not semantic identity
